_comment: CPE answers for the components whose own repository declares no CPE.
zspdx copies whatever a module puts under 'security.external-references' in
its zephyr/module.yml into the SBOM as an ExternalRef. Exactly one module in
this build declares one -- mbedtls, which ships
cpe:2.3:a:arm:mbed_tls:3.6.2 -- so a scan of a stock build can only ever
match mbedtls. Every other component arrives as
pkg:github/<org>/<repo>@<commit>, which no advisory database indexes, and is
therefore invisible to vulnerability scanning.
This file is the human answer for the rest. It is read by enrich_sbom.py and
is meant to be edited by the team, not generated. Keys are 'org/repo'
exactly as they appear in the SPDX PackageDownloadLocation.
'revision' is the module revision the entry was verified against. The CPE is
applied only while the SBOM still records that revision, so bumping a pin
disables the entry rather than asserting a version for a commit nobody
checked. When that happens enrich_sbom.py prints a 'CPE map skip' line --
grep the build log for it after any dependency bump.
Only add an entry you can justify twice:
1. the version comes from the pinned source itself, and
2. a scanner or the NVD API actually matches that CPE to CVEs.
The 'evidence' field is where that gets written down.
A wrong entry is worse than no entry: it attributes another product's CVEs
to this firmware, or masks the real ones. Most components here have no
usable CPE at all, and 'not_covered' records what was tried, so the next
person does not repeat the investigation.

zephyrproject-rtos/fatfs.version_source: include/ff.h in the pinned revision: 'FatFs - Generic FAT Filesystem module R0.15a' (FF_DEFINED 5380)
zephyrproject-rtos/fatfs.evidence: Grype 0.122.0 matches 6 CVEs against this CPE: CVE-2026-6682, -6683, -6684, -6686, -6687, -6688. The NVD API returns the same 6 for the product, and all 6 CVEs NVD holds for it carry the elm-chan:fatfs CPE.

telink-semi/xz.version_source: src/liblzma/api/lzma/version.h in the pinned revision: LZMA_VERSION 5.5.0, stability ALPHA -- a development snapshot between the 5.4 and 5.6 releases, not a published tarball
telink-semi/xz.evidence: Grype 0.122.0 matches 3 CVEs against this CPE: CVE-2025-31115, CVE-2024-47611, CVE-2026-34743. The repository is a fork of tukaani-project/xz (its homepage is tukaani.org/xz), so the upstream product identity is not in doubt even though the fork is Telink's.

not_covered.zephyrproject-rtos/mbedtls: Covered upstream: the module's own zephyr/module.yml declares cpe:2.3:a:arm:mbed_tls:3.6.2, which zspdx copies on to mbedtls-deps. Adding it here as well would report the same CVEs twice.
not_covered.zephyrproject-rtos/openthread: No CPE in NVD belongs to the library. Of the CVEs whose text mentions openthread, the CPEs are openthread:wpantund (a different tool), google:nest_wifi_point_firmware and oracle:database_server. Probed cpe:2.3:a:google:openthread:1.0.0 through Grype: zero matches.
not_covered.zephyrproject-rtos/mcuboot: No CPE: NVD holds 12 CVEs mentioning mcuboot and not one of them carries a cpeMatch.
not_covered.zephyrproject-rtos/littlefs: No CPE of its own; CVEs mentioning littlefs are attributed to zephyrproject:zephyr or to an unrelated Windows archiver.
not_covered.zephyrproject-rtos/lvgl: No CPE in the NVD dictionary -- a keyword search returns no non-deprecated product.
not_covered.zephyrproject-rtos/tinycrypt: No CPE; the single CVE that mentions tinycrypt carries no cpeMatch.
not_covered.zephyrproject-rtos/tflite-micro: The only nearby CPE is google:tensorflow, which is TensorFlow proper rather than TFLite Micro. Mapping it would import unrelated CVEs.
not_covered.zephyrproject-rtos/mipi-sys-t: No CPE in the NVD dictionary.
not_covered.zephyrproject-rtos/percepio: No CPE; TraceRecorder is commercial and absent from NVD.
not_covered.zephyrproject-rtos/segger: No CPE; SEGGER RTT is absent from NVD.
not_covered.telink-semi/hal_telink: Telink's own HAL: no upstream product, therefore no CPE.
not_covered.telink-semi/openthread_telink_lib: Telink fork of OpenThread, and inherits the problem above.
not_covered.telink-semi/tflite-micro-telink: Telink fork of TFLite Micro; same problem as tflite-micro above.
not_covered.zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr: cpe:2.3:o:zephyrproject:zephyr does exist and zspdx emits it for the Zephyr release itself, but this pin is a development branch with no release version to state. Probes at 3.7.0 and 4.1.0 each match zero CVEs.
not_covered.Aaronlu1/tl_matter: The product under construction: it is the subject of the SBOM, not a dependency of it.
